sql:
SELECT c.customer_type,
 SUM(si.claim_amount) AS total_claim_amount
FROM safety_incidents si
JOIN trips t ON si.trip_id = t.trip_id
JOIN loads l ON t.load_id = l.load_id
JOIN customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_type
ORDER BY total_claim_amount DESC;
SELECT AVG(CASE WHEN on_time_flag THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100 AS on_time_percentage FROM delivery_events;
SELECT SUM(total_cost) AS total_fuel_cost FROM fuel_purchases WHERE year(purchase_date) = 2023;

SELECT c.customer_type, AVG(t.actual_duration_hours) AS avg_trip_duration_hours
FROM trips t
JOIN loads l ON t.load_id = l.load_id
JOIN customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.customer_type
ORDER BY avg_trip_duration_hours DESC;

WITH load_trip AS (
 SELECT l.customer_id, t.actual_distance_miles, l.revenue
 FROM loads l
 JOIN trips t ON l.load_id = t.load_id
), cust_agg AS (
 SELECT c.customer_type,
 SUM(lt.revenue) AS total_revenue,
 SUM(lt.actual_distance_miles) AS total_miles
 FROM load_trip lt
 JOIN customers c ON lt.customer_id = c.customer_id
 GROUP BY c.customer_type
)
SELECT customer_type,
 total_revenue / NULLIF(total_miles, 0) AS revenue_per_mile
FROM cust_agg
ORDER BY revenue_per_mile DESC;
SELECT SUM(actual_distance_miles) / NULLIF(SUM(fuel_gallons_used), 0) AS overall_mpg FROM trips;

SELECT c.customer_type,
 100.0 * SUM(si.claim_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(l.revenue),0) AS safety_claims_pct
FROM loads l
JOIN customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
LEFT JOIN trips t ON l.load_id = t.load_id
LEFT JOIN safety_incidents si ON t.trip_id = si.trip_id
GROUP BY c.customer_type
ORDER BY safety_claims_pct DESC;

WITH fault AS (
 SELECT COUNT(*) AS fault_count
 FROM safety_incidents
 WHERE at_fault_flag = true
), miles AS (
 SELECT SUM(actual_distance_miles) AS total_miles
 FROM trips
)
SELECT 
 (fault.fault_count / NULLIF(miles.total_miles,0)) * 1000000 AS at_fault_rate_per_million_miles
FROM fault, miles;

WITH total AS (
 SELECT f.facility_type,
 COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries
 FROM delivery_events d
 JOIN facilities f ON d.facility_id = f.facility_id
 GROUP BY f.facility_type
), delayed AS (
 SELECT f.facility_type,
 COUNT(*) AS delayed_deliveries
 FROM delivery_events d
 JOIN facilities f ON d.facility_id = f.facility_id
 WHERE d.detention_minutes > 120
 GROUP BY f.facility_type
)
SELECT t.facility_type,
 (COALESCE(d.delayed_deliveries, 0) * 100.0) / NULLIF(t.total_deliveries, 0) AS detention_percentage
FROM total t
LEFT JOIN delayed d USING (facility_type)
ORDER BY detention_percentage DESC;
SELECT (COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE termination_date IS NOT NULL) * 100.0) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS driver_turnover_rate_percentage FROM drivers;
SELECT AVG(2024 - model_year) AS average_truck_age_years FROM trucks WHERE status = 'Active';
SELECT SUM(idle_time_hours) / NULLIF(SUM(actual_duration_hours), 0) * 100 AS idle_time_percentage FROM trips;

WITH fp AS (
 SELECT trip_id, SUM(total_cost) AS total_fuel_cost
 FROM fuel_purchases
 GROUP BY trip_id
), tr AS (
 SELECT t.trip_id, t.load_id, t.actual_distance_miles
 FROM trips t
 JOIN fp ON t.trip_id = fp.trip_id
 WHERE t.actual_distance_miles > 0
)
SELECT c.customer_type,
 SUM(fp.total_fuel_cost) / NULLIF(SUM(tr.actual_distance_miles), 0) AS fuel_cost_per_mile
FROM tr
JOIN loads l ON tr.load_id = l.load_id
JOIN customers c ON l.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN fp ON tr.trip_id = fp.trip_id
GROUP BY c.customer_type
ORDER BY fuel_cost_per_mile DESC;

WITH maint AS (
 SELECT truck_id, SUM(total_cost) AS total_maint_cost
 FROM maintenance_records
 GROUP BY truck_id
), drv AS (
 SELECT truck_id, SUM(actual_distance_miles) AS total_miles
 FROM trips
 GROUP BY truck_id
), truck_stats AS (
 SELECT m.truck_id,
 t.make,
 m.total_maint_cost,
 d.total_miles,
 CASE WHEN d.total_miles > 0 THEN m.total_maint_cost / (d.total_miles / 1000.0) ELSE NULL END AS maint_cost_per_1000_miles
 FROM maint m
 JOIN drv d ON m.truck_id = d.truck_id
 JOIN trucks t ON m.truck_id = t.truck_id
)
SELECT make,
 SUM(total_maint_cost) AS make_total_maint_cost,
 SUM(total_miles) AS make_total_miles,
 SUM(total_maint_cost) / (SUM(total_miles) / 1000.0) AS maint_cost_per_1000_miles
FROM truck_stats
GROUP BY make
ORDER BY maint_cost_per_1000_miles DESC
LIMIT 1;
